{{Quote|Goodness gracious! So dangerous! The fire-kraken&hellip;''"<br />"''Are no longer an issue.|[[Doolb Snoil]] and Kit Fisto discuss the fire-kraken|<ref name="CD" />}}
The '''fire-kraken''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Ocean/Legends|marine]] predator<ref name="CD" /> that dwelt in the deepest<ref name="CSWE" /> oceanic trenches of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]<ref name="CD" /> within the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Their most distinguishing feature was the [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like tendrils they possessed, which they used to locate and capture prey.<ref name="CSWE" /> The species' presence in the trenches made [[Diver|trench-diving]] on Nal Hutta particularly dangerous; however in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] claimed that they were no longer a problem, having previously spent a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] trench diving on Hutta himself.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fire-kraken were first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[The Cestus Deception]]'', which was written by [[Steven Barnes]],<ref name="CD" /> and also received an entry in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The novel used the plural to refer to the fire-kraken, suggesting there were more than one<ref name="CD" /> although the entry in the encyclopedia uses the singular suggesting that there was only one fire-kraken.<ref name="CSWE" /> This article assumes the former is correct and that the encyclopedia referred to a specific member of an entire species.
